title: Ignore raw string contents when collecting Lean axiom queries
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The Lean axiom helper can print `PASS 1 declarations` without executing any real `#print axioms` query: a raw string containing interior quotes exposes a fake query to the source scanner, and an `IO.println` supplies the corresponding report. Conversely, raw-string documentation can cause a valid audit to fail.

Mask Lean raw strings through the matching quote/hash delimiter before collecting queries. Cover zero and multiple hashes, literal backslashes, shorter nonclosing delimiters, unterminated strings, and adjacent ASCII/Unicode identifier tokens. Keep the existing report/axiom checks and the three existing `AuditAll.lean` query inventories unchanged.

This is a bounded verification-tool repair. It changes no theorem, frozen input, certificate, selected result or κ. The helper is still not a complete Lean parser or authentication against arbitrary hostile elaborators/loggers; Lean compilation and source review remain trust boundaries.

## Task and overlap

- Canonical base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`; priority revision 6.
- Card: `portable-replay`, scope key `831cc1a3c8f9ff01b197`. **Scope changed** from environment/artifact comparisons to a concrete source-scanner failure in the live Lean verification path. Reliable audit results are the connection to the verifier-engineering track; no mechanism improvement is claimed.
- Read the handoff hub before selection. The closest predecessor is @ywz65's #2523 at `f839ed0aca28280aea47c724937a2da04e5b7bcd`, which handles comments and ordinary strings. This patch adds raw-string coverage to that implementation.
- Refetched canonical main before submission. The overlap helper refreshed all 316 open PR bodies and 2,437 discussion records on 2026-10-18 at 08:04–08:05 UTC, without warnings; `raw string` / `check_lean_axioms` had no matches. Separate all-state PR searches found #2523 and no equivalent follow-up. These checks do not establish universal novelty.

## Validation

Environment: macOS arm64, Python 3.11.6, Lean 4.21.0 (`6741444a63ee`, the historical formal package's pinned version).

- [x] Actual Lean compiles the raw-string spoof fixture and emits the fake report. The unmodified helper exits 0 with `PASS 1 declarations`; the fixed helper exits 1 because there are no real queries.
- [x] All 8 test methods pass with live Lean enabled, including raw-string and adjacent-token positive controls, direct compilation of the spoof, original comment/string controls, multiline custom axioms, and `sorryAx` rejection.
- [x] Three existing audit command inventories remain identical.
- [x] `python3 -B scripts/research_baseline.py` reports `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY` (orientation/source bindings only).
- [x] `git diff --check`.

Reproduce the focused suite:

```sh
LEAN_AUDIT_BIN=/path/to/lean-4.21.0/bin \
  python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_lean_axiom_audit_parser.py -v
```

Without `LEAN_AUDIT_BIN`, the pure scanner/report/inventory checks run and the live test is explicitly skipped. Full formal-project builds, the selected mathematical replay, other OS runtimes and hosted CI have not been run for this scoped change.

Retain the existing helper authors and @ywz65's #2523 source-scanner work. Prepared for @roger-sato with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
